name: Mesu Tsumami 3 ~Shikkari Toshishitazuma to Toshiuezuma to Ero Hame Nikuyoku Seikatsu~
original_name: メスつまみ３ ～しっかり年下妻とおっとり年上妻とのエロハメ肉欲性活～
source:
The main character originally worked as a company employee, however, at the request of his relatives, he is assigned as a live-in caretaker of an apartment building.

He and a friendly part-time housewife, Chiaki Akabane, have been living there for a while, Wakana Takanashi, a calm housewife who moved in temporarily to renovate her house.

Through his work as caretaker and their personal lives, the two married women become close friends.

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc074/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主角原本是一名公司职员，应亲戚的请求，转而担任公寓的住家管理员。

公寓里住着性格爽朗、做着兼职的主妇赤羽千晶，还有因自家装修而暂时搬来的温和主妇高梨和奏。

通过管理员的工作与日常生活，主角与这两位人妻逐渐熟络起来。

[摘自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc074/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
